description: A template two directories below an entrypoint's `src` gains a `<video>` while 1.2.1 keeps resting on the scan that forbids one. ng-packagr compiles what the entry file reaches, at any depth, and the reader took one level of the secondary entrypoints until 2026-10-19: the scan found none. The file is laid on disk and read by the reader the live run reads with (`tree`), so the case holds the reader and not only the scan.
